mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vip_records (user_id, order_id, change_type, vip_level_before, vip_level_after, expire_before, expire_after, duration_days, amount_cents, remark) VALUES (#{userId}, #{orderId}, #{changeType}, #{vipLevelBefore}, #{vipLevelAfter}, #{expireBefore}, #{expireAfter}, #{durationDays}, #{amountCents}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM vip_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM vip_records WHERE user_id = #{userId}
